name: Spread lister current-min-max
summary: This utility EA monitors and displays the current, minimum, and maximum spread values for the trading instrument. It does not open any trades but serves as a spread monitoring tool for traders who want to track spread conditions in real-time.
summary_zh: 该工具EA监控并显示交易品种的当前、最小和最大点差值。它不进行任何交易，而是作为点差监控工具，帮助交易者实时跟踪点差条件。
strategy_analysis: 该EA是一个纯工具型程序，不包含任何交易策略逻辑，仅用于监控和记录点差数据。其核心功能是实时追踪当前点差，并在会话期间记录点差的最小值和最大值。没有入场条件或出场条件，因为它不执行任何交易操作。仓位管理和资金管理完全不存在，因为该工具不涉及任何订单的开设或管理。主要用途是帮助剥头皮交易者或其他对点差敏感的交易者判断当前交易环境是否适合进场，以及评估经纪商的点差质量。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is a pure utility program that contains no trading strategy logic, solely designed to monitor and record spread data. Its core function is to track the current spread in real-time and record the minimum and maximum spread values during the session. There are no entry or exit conditions since it does not execute any trading operations. Position sizing and money management are completely absent as the tool does not involve any order placement or management. Its primary use is to help scalpers or other spread-sensitive traders determine whether current trading conditions are suitable for entry, and to evaluate the broker's spread quality over time.
pros: 轻量级工具，不占用过多系统资源，不影响交易性能
提供实时和历史点差数据，帮助交易者选择最佳入场时机
直观的可视化显示，不同颜色区分当前、最小和最大点差，便于快速判断
适用于剥头皮和高频交易者评估经纪商执行质量
可以辅助判断何时避开高点差时段以降低交易成本
pros_en: Lightweight utility that doesn't consume excessive system resources or affect trading performance
Provides real-time and historical spread data to help traders choose optimal entry timing
Intuitive visual display with different colors for current, minimum, and maximum spread for quick assessment
Useful for scalpers and high-frequency traders to evaluate broker execution quality
Helps identify when to avoid high-spread periods to reduce trading costs
cons: 不执行交易，仅提供信息，功能单一
缺少点差历史记录保存功能，重启后数据丢失
没有警报功能，当点差超过阈值时无法通知交易者
缺少多点差品种同时监控能力
没有与交易策略的集成接口，无法自动根据点差调整交易行为
cons_en: Does not execute trades, only provides information with limited single functionality
Lacks spread history persistence, data is lost on EA restart
No alert functionality to notify traders when spread exceeds a threshold
No integration interface with trading strategies to automatically adjust trading behavior based on spread
improvements: 增加点差阈值警报功能，当点差超过设定值时发送通知
添加点差历史数据保存到文件的功能，便于长期分析经纪商点差质量
improvements_en: Add spread threshold alert functionality to send notifications when spread exceeds a set value
Add spread history data export to file for long-term analysis of broker spread quality

risk_points: 不涉及任何交易风险，纯粹的监控工具
可能存在依赖过时点差数据的误导风险，如果EA长时间未刷新
risk_points_en: No trading risk involved, purely a monitoring tool
Potential risk of misleading reliance on stale spread data if the EA doesn't refresh frequently enough

summary_en: This utility EA monitors and displays the current, minimum, and maximum spread values for the trading instrument. It does not open any trades but serves as a spread monitoring tool for traders who want to track spread conditions in real-time.
